content: Google raised the price of its 4K streaming box to $149, up $50 from its original $99 price. The new price is currently live at the Google Store and Best Buy, but Amazon appears to still be offering the original price.  The price hike comes just a couple of weeks after Google launched its new lineup of Pixel 11 phones with a $100 price hike over their Pixel 10 counterparts.  The Google TV Streamer originally launched in 2024 and doubles as a smart home hub. It isn’t the only streaming device getting more expensive — component shortages have been driving up prices on everything from laptops to game consoles. Earlier this month, Amazon increased the price of its Fire TV Stick 4K Max by over 40 percent to $84.99. The Apple TV 4K also similarly costs more after Apple’s sweeping price hikes in June, bringing it up to $199 for the 64GB version and $249 for the 128GB version.
chineseTitle: Google TV Streamer 现在价格上涨 50 美元
chineseSummary: 谷歌将 4K 流媒体盒的价格提高至 149 美元，比原价 99 美元上涨了 50 美元。新价格目前已在谷歌商店和百思买上发布，但亚马逊似乎仍在提供原价。谷歌推出新产品几周后就涨价了 [...]
chineseContent: 谷歌将 4K 流媒体盒的价格提高至 149 美元，比原价 99 美元上涨了 50 美元。新价格目前已在谷歌商店和百思买上发布，但亚马逊似乎仍在提供原价。  就在几周前，谷歌推出了新的 Pixel 11 手机系列，价格比 Pixel 10 手机上涨了 100 美元。  Google TV Streamer 最初于 2024 年推出，兼作智能家居中心。它并不是唯一一个价格上涨的流媒体设备——组件短缺已经推高了从笔记本电脑到游戏机等各种设备的价格。本月早些时候，亚马逊将 Fire TV Stick 4K Max 的价格提高了 40% 以上，达到 84.99 美元。在苹果公司 6 月份大幅提价后，Apple TV 4K 的价格也同样上涨，64GB 版本涨至 199 美元，128GB 版本涨至 249 美元。
